name: The Eyes of Drizlash
vestige: Drizlash, who spins between the walls
summary: A 30 ft climbing speed, darkvision 120 ft, and Web a few times a day. The price: Charisma -2, extra eyes that never close, and trouble in sunlight.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_faceless_god (the ring of amber).

benefit.text: Walls and ceilings are floors to you now, the dark is a lit room, and you can spin a web from your palms.

cost.flaw: Four small black eyes have opened along your hairline. They don't close, and people can't stop looking at them.
cost.text: Your new eyes can't bear the day: in direct sunlight you have Disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

implemented: partial: the sunlight penalty is text only (no sunlight modifiers for characters yet).
